target_bug.title: Dropped hidden item remains hidden from room description

hints.weak: Explore whether item visibility stays consistent when hidden or contained items move between inventory and rooms.
hints.medium: Focus on item visibility after taking something from a hidden or contained state. Verify whether dropping that item into the room makes it visible again.
hints.strong: Open the bedroom nightstand, take the small key, drop it, then execute `look`. The likely defect is in `GameWorld.drop_item`, which moves the item without clearing its hidden flag.

target_bug.hint: Focus on item visibility after taking something from a hidden or contained state. Verify whether dropping that item into the room makes it visible again.
target_bug.expected_behavior: A dropped item should be visible in the current room description after it leaves the player's inventory.
target_bug.observed_fault: An item that was previously hidden can remain hidden after being dropped, so the room state changes but the visible room description omits it.
reproduction: Open the nightstand and take the small key.
Drop the small key in the bedroom.
Execute `look` and observe whether the small key appears in the room description.
